newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: KEDO tenders to buy April residual fuel.
newsitem.headline: KEDO tenders to buy April residual fuel.

text.p: The Korean Peninsula Energy Development Organisation (KEDO) has issued a tender to buy up to 64,000 tonnes of residual fuel in April, traders said on Tuesday.
The tender seeks 42,000 tonnes or 20,000 tonnes of residual fuel for delivery around April 6-17 to Nampu or Songrim.
It also requires the delivery of another 22,000 tonnes of residual fuel for delivery to Songbong around April 6-15.
The tender close March 26 and is valid for one day.
KEDO, an international organisation established to implement nuclear non-proliferation in North Korea, has agreed to supply the country with 500,000 tonnes of fuel oil annually.
